  • Establish engineering practices, tooling, and standards early on

  • Adapt quickly as priorities and requirements shif

Requirements

Requirements

  • Strong full-stack development skills and system design fundamentals

  • Excellent communication and ownership mindset

  • Track record of shipping and scaling products independently

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered product development

Lead product development, shape architecture, and build scalable systems from the ground up.

About the Role

Own the product experience and platform for an AI-powered renewable energy diligence service. You will work directly with customers and expert reviewers to build and ship tools that help accelerate financing and development of energy infrastructure projects.

What You'll Do

  • Talk with customers and translate their needs into product improvements.

  • Design, build, and ship features across the customer, analyst, and expert reviewer experience.

  • Develop and operate the platform supporting AI-assisted document review and diligence workflows.

  • Build systems that keep customer data isolated, access-controlled, and auditable.

  • Ensure extracted claims are grounded in source documents, and route unsupported questions to expert reviewers.

  • Use measurable experiments to evaluate changes, monitor accuracy, and address regressions.

What We're Looking For

  • Two or more years of experience, with startup experience as a founding engineer or an early team member.

  • Full-stack engineering experience across frontend and backend development.

  • Experience with agent architectures or LLM-powered workflows.

  • Experience building document processing, retrieval, or extraction systems.

  • Familiarity with Rails, React, Postgres, or Elasticsearch.

  • Background in fintech, legaltech, proptech, or energy and infrastructure.

  • Ability to work in North American time zones.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $130,000 to $150,000 USD annually, with meaningful equity. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Remote, with a primary location in Canada.

We're building the future of recruiting with AI – and we need an exceptional engineer to join our founding team in our San Francisco hackerhouse.

We just raised a $3M pre-seed from top-tier investors and are looking for someone to be one of our first engineering hires. This is the real deal: meaningful equity, direct impact on product direction, and the chance to build something massive in a $600B industry ripe for disruption.

What We're Building:

Clera is reimagining how top talent finds their dream jobs. We're already working with leading VC-backed startups like Mintlify, Luminai, and Windsurf – automating the entire headhunting process end-to-end with AI agents.

Thousands of talents engage with Clera every week. We've helped many land roles at companies they're genuinely excited about. Traditional recruiting is broken – we're fixing it with AI-first automation that delivers better outcomes for both candidates and companies.

We're at the perfect inflection point: early enough that you'll have massive ownership and impact, but far enough that we have a working product, paying customers, and strong traction.

The Role:

You'll be engineer #4 on the founding team, working directly with our CTO and the other founding engineers. You'll ship features to production daily and own entire product areas from concept to deployment.

We're building fully agentic systems that automate complex workflows. It's technically challenging, fast-paced, and high-impact.

Your Experience:

  • Very strong software engineering background: Experience in TypeScript and React

  • Strong practical experience working with AI: We work 24/7 in Cursor - ideally you have experience coding with AI. Bonus if you have an experience working with LLM APIs

  • Startup mindset - high agency, resourceful, and obsessed with creating value

Who You Are:

  • Take full ownership of projects, from concept to deployment and do whatever it takes to get the job done.

  • Write code fast and scrap it even faster, but know when to transition to building for scale and quality.

  • Enjoy talking to customers and iterating based on feedback.

  • Are willing to work hard, to create something new with a lot of impact, changing how millions of talents find their jobs in the future.

Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, Cursor, Supabase, Prisma, Typesense, LLM APIs,

The SF Hackerhouse Setup:

We're living and building together in SF. Zero commute, 10× faster feedback loops, constant collaboration.

It's intense, but it's also incredibly productive and fun. You'll be surrounded by A-players who are all-in on building something great.

Why Join Now:

  • Be engineer #4 – your decisions will shape the entire product

  • True ownership, no micromanagement, shipping to production every day

  • Experienced founders and a team of A Players

  • Meaningful equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Join before we scale 10-100×

  • We can support with visa processes

Compensation: Competitive salary + significant equity

If you're the kind of engineer who wants to build fast, own outcomes, and create something that matters – let's talk.

  • Ability to ship and iterate promptly while maintaining clean, reliable code.

On-site in New York, New York. Relocation support is available.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

  • Proto is making the world's biggest macro themes directly tradable for the first time: data center growth, AI capex, GPU manufacturing, US foreign arms sales, as easy as trading on Robinhood. Private mainnet beta on Solana launching Fall 2026.

  • We’re building a new market mechanism designed to improve how markets handle a broader range of scalar outcomes. Rather than re-using perpetual futures or traditional binary predictions, our approach enables more continuous price discovery through a novel market structure, creating a more efficient and intuitive trading experience while enabling 10-20x leverage.

  • Built by a veteran ex-Phantom team (VP Product at Ondo, Quant Research at Citadel, experience leading teams at Google, Pinterest, Facebook, and Carta), with early angels including the founders of Phantom, Jito, Pendle, Goldsky, Meld, and SimpleHash.

Description

We're looking for a founding engineer to own the backend and quantitative systems that power our prediction market products. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between architecture, implementation, research, and production operations and who wants meaningful influence over both the product and the engineering organization.

What we're looking for

  • A founding-engineer mindset: high ownership, speed, pragmatism, and comfort operating with ambiguity

  • Strong backend engineering and system design fundamentals

  • Experience building reliable, scalable, data-intensive systems

  • Quantitative or research-oriented ability, such as experience with trading systems, financial data, modeling, experimentation, or translating research ideas into production systems

  • Experience with DeFi protocols and financial primitives, such as lending and borrowing markets, collateralized debt positions, stablecoins, automated market makers, liquid staking, restaking, real-world asset protocols, tokenized treasuries, or on-chain credit systems

  • Strong ability to reason about, direct, and validate AI-assisted software development, with a focus on producing efficient, reliable, production-quality code

  • 3+ years of full-time experience in web3/crypto development

  • 4+ years of professional engineering experience, excluding internships, in relevant roles at technology and product-driven companies.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with trading infrastructure, market data, exchanges, risk systems, payment systems, or other correctness-critical financial software

  • Experience with derivatives such as perpetuals, futures, options, CFDs, or prediction markets

  • Experience designing systems in which settlement correctness and reconciliation are load-bearing

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or protocol software

  • Experience working closely with quantitative researchers

  • Experience building protocols at scale ($10M+ TVL or 10k+ users)

  • Multiple Solana programs shipped to mainnet, in Anchor and/or native Solana. You are fluent in the account model, PDAs, CPIs, compute budgets, and the actual pitfalls - account substitution, owner-check oversight, bump-seed canonicalization, CPI reentrancy, sysvar swaps, realloc edge cases

How we work

  • Small, flat team with direct access to the founders

  • High ownership and fast decisions

  • Written reasoning and explicit technical tradeoffs

  • AI-assisted development with human accountability

  • A bias toward simple, observable, production-ready systems

What we offer

  • A founding engineer seat with substantial ownership of the technical architecture from day one

  • Direct influence over the product, roadmap, and engineering culture

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, calibrated to seniority and location

  • The opportunity to build a technically ambitious financial system from its earliest stage

  • Hybrid/remote options available, with team off-sites

  • Small flat team, fast decisions

  • Tax Planning Opportunities for maximizing QSBS Benefits

If you're interested:

  1. Send us your resume.

  2. Tell us something you built, or provide a short description of a production system you personally designed in 500 words or less.

Location: Remote, US or LATAM

Type: flexible

Compensation: Competitive cash + equity compensation; tailored to the candidate

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on founding engineering role with ownership of architecture, infrastructure, and engineering execution. You will strengthen and extend an established production platform, leading the existing engineering team.

You will take full ownership of technical decisions, implementation quality, and production operation. Josh leads product priorities and brings deep infrastructure-finance expertise; you translate those priorities into sound engineering decisions and dependable software. You will work with Josh and our financial modeling team to understand complex workflows and build reusable platform capabilities. Josh owns customer communication and discovery during the initial phase.

We are hiring for judgment and track record: someone who can evaluate an existing foundation, make disciplined tradeoffs, and lead delivery while remaining deeply involved in the code.

What You'll Own

Strong data modeling, calculation orchestration, integrations, versioning, and production reliability are central to this role, alongside the ability to deliver a complete customer-facing application.

1. Product and Application Engineering

Build the product end to end on the existing stack of Next.js, React, TypeScript, and a .net C# excel control layer. Design robust financial data models, reliable calculation orchestration, source-system integrations, and scenario and version controls. Make outputs traceable and reproducible, with reconciliation and review where required. Deliver clear, responsive interfaces for complex financial workflows.

2. Infrastructure and Architecture

Own and evolve the existing architecture, services, data layer, infrastructure as code, deployment environments, observability, and CI/CD. Make build-versus-buy decisions and lead technical planning and execution. Strengthen testing, performance, recovery, and release practices as deployments and usage grow. Turn customer requirements into shared capabilities, configuration, or bounded extensions.

3. Security and Sensitive Data

Own the engineering controls that protect confidential customer financial data: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, encryption, access control, and audit trails. Maintain reliable production operation through monitoring, backups, incident response, and controlled deployment and rollback. You are accountable for implementation and operation.

4. Product Collaboration and Team Leadership

Partner with the CEO and financial modelers to translate customer requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and software with clear acceptance criteria. Own engineering delivery and production readiness, with customer communication led by the CEO. There is potential for this role to participate directly in and own parts of that discovery and workflow over time once domain fluency is proven. Guide and mentor the engineering team, maintain code-review and delivery standards, and help assess future engineering hires.

Early Success

  • Deliver the remaining product and platform capabilities required to serve clients #3 & #4 in production.

  • Prepare Inframodel to scale across the market in 2027 through maintainable architecture, production reliability, and engineering practices that support a growing customer base and team.

Who We're Looking For

Must have

  • Experience building and shipping financial-modeling-oriented enterprise SaaS. You understand how financial assumptions, calculations, scenarios, and outputs interact, and have translated that logic into production software for finance users.

  • 10+ years building and shipping production software.

  • Demonstrated ownership of architecture, infrastructure, and production engineering, including infrastructure as code.

  • Deep experience with data modeling, calculation orchestration, integrations, versioning, and production reliability.

  • Strong full-stack command of TypeScript, React, and Next.js, with sound product and interface judgment.

  • Experience protecting sensitive financial data in enterprise software.

  • Experience building new products or substantial capabilities in a small team.

  • Professional-level English and the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to the founder and internal team.

  • Ability to independently own architecture, infrastructure, and engineering execution without requiring senior technical oversight.

Background we're targeting

You have owned complex financial software from architecture through production use. Relevant backgrounds include enterprise financial modeling, planning and forecasting, or fintech platforms where financial calculation and scenario logic are core to the product. We value evidence that you can combine hands-on delivery with sound architecture and operational discipline.

Nice to have

These strengthen an application but are not required.

  • Energy, infrastructure, or project-finance experience.

  • Experience with calculation engines, Excel automation, model parsing, or governed spreadsheet integration.

  • Experience scaling enterprise deployments through shared product capabilities and configuration.

  • A track record as an early engineer whose systems continued to operate and evolve.

  • Experience applying AI to financial workflows with source traceability, validation, and human review.

Introduction

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction. 

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT.  Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us! 

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

AIT, a global company with 170+ locations worldwide, is building the team that will build our next-generation technology. As part of this, we're opening a new development center in Tel Aviv.

The Founding Software Engineer, Skunkworks is an individual-contributor engineer on AIT's new Skunkworks team, responsible for building key elements of what a company of this size will run on. As a founding engineer on the new team, this role helps select the architecture, stack, and tooling, and establishes the engineering practices that will shape the next chapter of how the company develops software.

This is a hands-on role that designs, builds, and ships production systems solving real operational problems. The engineer works AI-natively, using agents, RAG, and LLM pipelines, and applies AI-assisted development as a daily force multiplier. They thrive in ambiguity - because the map isn't drawn yet.

The role ships to production and owns systems end-to-end in production, ensuring reliability, quality, auditability, and operational performance, and demos work directly to company leadership.

In addition to having a significant impact on the company's evolution in the software space, we offer a compensation package that is market-competitive in Israeli tech.

Join us, and you'll quickly see your work in the hands of the people who move freight.

Responsibilities

  • Platform Architecture & Build
    • Build AIT's next-generation technology from the ground up, contributing to the selection of architecture, stack, and tooling.
    • Partner with operations stakeholders to translate appropriate operational pain points into shipped software.
    • Make and document the foundational technical decisions expected of a founding engineer on the Skunkworks team.
  • AI-Native Development
    • Design, build, and operate capabilities using agents, RAG, and LLM pipelines.
    • Apply AI-assisted development as a daily force multiplier across the engineering workflow.
    • Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, and tooling and adopt what measurably improves delivery.
  • Production Ownership
    • Ship to production and own systems end-to-end in production.
    • Ensure the reliability, quality, and operational performance of the systems this role builds.
  • Engineering Culture & Practices
    • Establish the engineering practices, standards, and quality bar across the work this role builds.
    • Demo work directly to company leadership as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience with a demonstrated track record of success.
    • Master’s degree in computer science or a related field is preferred.
  • Experience
    • Proven experience delivering software solutions end-to-end, with accountability for deployment, reliability, and ongoing production support.
    • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools and AI-assisted development techniques as a core part of the software development lifecycle.

  • Tackle a wide breadth of engineering challenges. Our work spans AI, data engineering, backend, frontend, and more — so there's plenty of opportunity to find projects that match your strengths and interests. Some examples include:

  • Shape Clipbook's engineering culture. What We're Looking For

  • 2–10+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies. You've taken systems from zero to production and owned the full lifecycle.

  • Proficiency with web technologies (Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, etc.)

  • Genuine excitement to build quickly & ship fast. We care about getting things into users' hands and iterating from there.

  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with cloud-based services, containerization, and API development.

  • Experience optimizing data architectures for performance and cost.

  • You take ownership. When something is broken or unclear, you fix it or flag it without waiting to be asked.

  • A future leader. You'll help shape our engineering culture and can quickly grow into engineering leadership as the company scales.

  • Experience with any of the following:

    • LLM fine-tuning, RAG, RLHF, or eval pipelines

    • Computer vision or multimodal model experience (audio, video, image)

    • Semantic search, vector databases, or meaning-aware retrieval

    • Familiarity with web scraping frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer) and different types of API integrations (REST, GraphQL)

    • Comfort with asynchronous workflows, rate-limiting, and distributed systems

  • Startup founder or early-stage experience is a huge plus.

What This Role Is Not

We're hiring across the full stack with a focus on building product. This probably isn't the right fit if your background is primarily in firmware, embedded systems, hardware engineering, networking, or infrastructure/DevOps.

A Few Things Worth Knowing

  • We care more about what you ship than when or where you work, but this is an early-stage company growing fast. The pace reflects that. Our culture is intense and driven by H&H (hunger and hustle).

  • As one of the first engineers, you'll wear a lot of hats. There's no platform team to hand things off to yet.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $150K–$220K

  • Equity: Early-stage grant with significant upside

  • Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), unlimited PTO

Growth: A clear path to engineering leadership as we scale

About Vulcury

Vulcury is a venture studio building a portfolio of companies anchored by proprietary semantic infrastructure. Our two lead ventures are Trustbridge, a manufacturing and supply chain matchmaking platform, and Calisade, an investment research and asset management venture with a strong performance track record. We are backed by a committed lead investor and operate with a small, deliberately senior team.

This is a founding technical role. You will be the first senior engineer in the company and the day-to-day technical leader for everything we build.

The Opportunity

We are hiring one person to own the build-out of our first production product (the Trustbridge supplier app) and to grow into the senior technical anchor across the entire studio. This is not a contractor role and not a project hire. We are looking for someone who wants a long-horizon seat at a company in formation, with the range to be redeployed across multiple problem domains as the portfolio matures.

In your first six months you will ship a real product to real users. In year two you will help define the cross-portfolio data and AI infrastructure that becomes our durable competitive advantage. In year three, if things go well, you will be leading a team.

What You Will Do

  • Own the technical build of the first-generation Trustbridge supplier app end-to-end: architecture, model selection, agent design, inference layer, and production deployment.

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 junior engineers and interns based in India. Set the technical bar, run code reviews, and grow the team's capability.

  • Translate business and product specifications into buildable technical plans. You will work directly with the founder, who owns domain logic but is not a builder.

  • Collaborate with our Fractional CTO (background in major financial technology) on architecture decisions and technical strategy.

  • Once the first-generation product is in production, help shape the cross-portfolio semantic layer that connects Trustbridge, Calisade, and future ventures.

  • Be redeployed, over time, to new internal products and external client engagements as the practice grows.

Who You Are

  • 7–12 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on applied ML or AI systems.

  • You have shipped a production ML or AI system end-to-end — not just a prototype, not just a research artifact. You can talk concretely about what broke and what you learned.

  • You are a generalist by temperament. You are comfortable across model selection, agent orchestration (LLM-based and otherwise), basic data engineering, and inference architecture. You do not need to be the world expert in any one of these, but you need to be competent in all of them.

  • You have led junior engineers before. You know how to set a technical bar without micromanaging, and you know how to grow people.

  • You write clearly. You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical founder without condescension and without hand-waving.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. Our first product is a discovery instrument — the requirements will evolve as real users start using it, and you need to be the kind of engineer who finds that energizing rather than frustrating.

  • You want to build something that lasts. You are looking for a long-term seat, not a resume line.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with dbt, modern data warehouse design, or feature stores.

  • Background in supply chain, manufacturing, financial services, or investment data.

  • Prior experience as a founding or early engineer at a venture-backed startup.

  • Experience working across time zones with US-based founders or clients.

Compensation

Competitive base salary calibrated to senior engineering roles at top-tier Indian technology companies and well-funded startups, plus meaningful equity in Vulcury Ventures LLC. Equity vests over four years with a one-year cliff. Specific numbers will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

How to Apply

Send a short note (please, no long cover letters) to [email] explaining: (1) the most interesting production ML or AI system you have shipped and what you would do differently if you built it again, (2) what you are looking for in the next chapter of your career, and (3) one technical opinion you hold that you think most people get wrong. Attach a CV or a link to your work.

We will respond to every credible application. The interview process is four conversations: an initial call with the founder, a technical conversation with our Fractional CTO, a working session on a real problem from our roadmap, and a closing conversation on fit and compensation. We aim to move from first call to offer in three weeks for candidates we are excited about.

Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety.

The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.

The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.

As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation.

We are hiring one person to own the product's engineering end-to-end. You will be the technical owner of the AI Coach and the systems around it, reporting directly to a non-technical founder. You are a self-starter who takes a brief, breaks it into a plan, communicates the plan, executes it, and reports outcomes - with direction from the founder but without needing technical supervision.

  • Bias to shipping: small, frequent, reversible releases with monitoring and rollback in place

Requirements

  • Voice features (TTS/STT), push notification strategy, CRM/email platform integrations

Our stack:

Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL. Mobile: React Native. Web: React. Hosting: AWS Sydney. AI: OpenAI (plus OpenAI Moderation), Pinecone vector DB. Mobile services: Firebase. Payments: App Store, Google Play, Stripe. Analytics: AppsFlyer, GA4, Meta Pixel. Code: Bitbucket. Admin: SQLAdmin-based panel.

You report directly to the founder, who is not technical.
